reason: PlanEval offloads planning and retrieval evaluation to a small-scale planner-evaluator model so the LLM is invoked less for knowledge-intensive multi-step tasks, motivated by the cost and edge-deployment latency of LLM-heavy prompting; the contribution is a task-level agent framework, not an inference-system mechanism.
title: PlanEval: Augmenting Large Language Models With a Small-Scale Planner-Evaluator for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks
